# f5xc_fast_acls_for_internet_vips (Data Source)

namespace creates logical independent workspace within a tenant. Within a namespace contained objects should have unique names.<br><br>Object within a namespace can only refer to objects within the same namespace or shared namespace or ves-io/shared namespace<br><br>All monitoring is scoped by namespace<br><br>List within namespace lists objects within same namespace or shared namespace or ves-io/shared namespace<br><br>User roles can be scoped by namespace<br><br>The 'namespace' value of a namespace object itself is empty string

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Fast Acls For Internet Vips - Full

data "f5xc_fast_acls_for_internet_vips" "example" {
  namespace = f5xc_fast_acls_for_internet_vips.example.namespace
}
```
